The packet Claude Code received held the clause diff, Kane's values, every line above and a definition of done. Nothing in it mentions the held-out edit: the loop refuses to build a packet that does.

The store now reads every policy number from the new policy-values block in policy.md through src/policy-file.js, and refuses all refunds, credits and escalations with POLICY_UNAVAILABLE if that block is missing, unreadable or disagrees with the prose. The prompt, tool descriptions, refusals and /orders copy are built from those values; a migration removes the old store-credit cap from existing database files; and the tests take their numbers from policy.md.

— Claude Code, summing up attempt 1 in its own words.
